MHEG: I stand by the wayside and ask the Way. If only someone would show me the Way to God-I would go with him.
Ever standing up I inquire of the way to my Lord. If some one shows me the way, I would go to Him.
BFM6: I follow in the footsteps of those who enjoy the Love of my Beloved.
I follow in the foot steps of those who have enjoyed my Beloved.
A1RJ: I beg of them, I implore them; I have such a yearning to meet God! ||1||
Them I beseech and them I entreat. I have a yearning to meet my Master.
H2SK: O my Siblings of Destiny, please unite me in Union with my Lord God.
My fellow Brother! let some one unite me in the union of my Lord God.
5A7Y: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who has shown me the Lord God. ||1||Pause||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who has shown to me the Lord Master. Pause.
WEXP: In deep humility, I fall at the Feet of the Perfect True Guru.
In utter humility, I lie prostrate before the Perfect True Guru.
7GGS: The Guru is the Honor of the dishonored. The Guru, the True Guru, brings approval and applause.
The Guru is the honour of the dishonoured. The great Sat Guru makes man applaudable.
RZU8: I am never tired of praising the Guru, who unites me with the Lord God. ||2||
I ever feel hungry for praising the Guru. He unites me with the Lord God.
NGJC: Everyone, all over the world, longs for the True Guru.
Every one the entire world and all long for the True Guru.
DRJE: Without the good fortune of destiny, the Blessed Vision of His Darshan is not obtained. The unfortunate ones just sit and cry.
Without good luck His sight cannot be had. The unfortunate sit and bewail.
02XB: All things happen according to the Will of the Lord God. No one can erase the pre-ordained Writ of Destiny. ||3||
Whatever is the Will of Lord God that does come to pass. None can erase the pre-ordained writ.
TM2D: He Himself is the True Guru; He Himself is the Lord. He Himself unites in His Union.
God Himself is the Sat Guru Himself the Lord and Him self unites man in His union.
0087: In His Kindness, He unites us with Himself, as we follow the Guru, the True Guru.
Making man follow the Great True Guru the Lord mercifully blends him with Himself.
1VSG: Over all the world, He is the Life of the World, O Nanak, like water mingled with water. ||4||4||68||
In this world the Lord Himself is the life of the entire Universe Like water merging into water O Nanak, God's slave gets absorbed in God.
UKR2: The Essence of the Ambrosial Naam is the most sublime essence; how can I get to taste this essence?
The relish of the immortalising Name Nectar is exquisitely fine. In what way can I obtain the Nectar to taste it?
VLDT: I go and ask the happy soul-brides, "How did you come to meet God?"
Go and ask the true wives as to how did they come to meet the Lord?
ADUN: They are care-free and do not speak; I massage and wash their feet. ||1||
They are care-free and tell not I repeatedly rub and wash their feet.
7Y5M: O Siblings of Destiny, meet with your spiritual friend, and dwell upon the Glorious Praises of the Lord.
O Brother! meet Guru the friend and heartily dwell upon God's Merits.
UKM4: The True Guru, the Primal Being, is your Friend, who shall drive out pain and subdue your ego. ||1||Pause||
Your Friends is the True Beings Guru who beats out and drives away the pangs of pride. Pause.
WHN2: The Gurmukhs are the happy soul-brides; their minds are filled with kindness.
The Guru-wards enjoy the nuptial-love, and their hearts are moved with compassion.
FF3A: The Word of the True Guru is the Jewel. One who believes in it tastes the Sublime Essence of the Lord.
The word of the True Guru is the emerald. He who accepts it tastes God's elixir.
PP33: Those who partake of the Lord's Sublime Essence, through the Guru's Love, are known as great and very fortunate. ||2||
They, who by Guru's love, partake of Lord's ambrosia are known to be great and exceedingly fortunate.
0GBD: This Sublime Essence of the Lord is in the forests, in the fields and everywhere, but the unfortunate ones do not taste it.
This elixir of God is contained in forest, straw and the whole universe but the unfortunate taste it not.
KC8Z: Without the True Guru, it is not obtained. The self-willed manmukhs continue to cry in misery.
Without the True Guru it is not obtained. The apostate remain bewailing.
AV38: They do not bow before the True Guru; the demon of anger is within them. ||3||
They bow not before the True Guru. In their heart is the goblin of wrath.
URJD: The Lord Himself, Har, Har, Har, is the Sublime Essence. The Lord Himself is the Essence.
God Himself is the relish of His Name and he Himself is the Divine elixir.
XW37: In His Kindness, He blesses the Gurmukh with it; the Ambrosial Nectar of this Amrit trickles down.
Showing His grace, God Himself gives the Name Nectar to the various and trickles it (into his mouth).
4KZM: Then, the body and mind totally blossom forth and flourish; O Nanak, the Lord comes to dwell within the mind. ||4||5||69||
Then O Nanak! man's body and soul are all reverdured and that God lives within his mind.
217R: The day dawns, and then it ends, and the night passes away.
The day dawns, then it sinks and the whole night passes away.
JJ93: Man's life is diminishing, but he does not understand. Each day, the mouse of death is gnawing away at the rope of life.
The age diminishes, but the man understands not. The mouse (of Time) is daily gnawing down the rope of life.
XV1Z: Maya spreads out like sweet molasses; the self-willed manmukh is stuck like a fly, rotting away. ||1||
Like sweet molasses is spread the mammon and clinging there to-like a fly an apostate pines and putrefies.
LDLZ: O Siblings of Destiny, God is my Friend and Companion.
O Brother! that Lord is my Friend and comrade.
JJLH: Emotional attachment to children and spouse is poison; in the end, no one will go along with you as your helper. ||1||Pause||
The love of sons and wife is poison. In the end none becomes mortals helper. Pause.2
ZU0X: Through the Guru's Teachings, some embrace love for the Lord, and are saved. They remain detached and unaffected, and they find the Sanctuary of the Lord.
Under Guru's instruction men are emancipated by embracing love for God and by seeking Lord's sanctuary, they remain detached from the world.

R4PL: They keep death constantly before their eyes; they gather the Provisions of the Lord's Name, and receive honor.
They ever keep death before their eyes, amass the viaticum of God's Name and receive honour.
BGA8: The Gurmukhs are honored in the Court of the Lord. The Lord Himself takes them in His Loving Embrace. ||2||
Guru-Beloveds are honoured in Lord's court. God himself takes them in His embrace.
T760: For the Gurmukhs, the Way is obvious. At the Lord's Door, they face no obstructions.
For the holy, the way to God is manifest. At Lord's door they face no obstruction.
K3KQ: They praise the Lord's Name, they keep the Naam in their minds, and they remain attached to the Love of the Naam.
They praise Lord's Name, keep the Name in mind and remain attached with the Name's love.
UNGF: The Unstruck Celestial Music vibrates for them at the Lord's Door, and they are honored at the True Door. ||3||
The unstruck music plays for them at God's Gate and they receive honour in the True court.
VKJB: Those Gurmukhs who praise the Naam are applauded by everyone.
They who have praised the Name, through the Guru ; them every one applauds.
8S7U: Grant me their company, God-I am a beggar; this is my prayer.
Grant me their association, Omy Lord! I a beggar of Yours, make this supplication.
7V5U: O Nanak, great is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who are filled with the Light of the Naam within. ||4||33||31||6||70||
Great is the luck of the pious persons, O Nanak! within whose heart is the light of God's Name.
1RW8: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, First House:
DMMJ: Why are you so thrilled by the sight of your son and your beautifully decorated wife?
Why are you intoxicated by beholding your son and bedecked wife?
2EGX: You enjoy tasty delicacies, you have lots of fun, and you indulge in endless pleasures.
You enjoyest delicacies, makest merry and indulgest in infinite pleasures.
1WNB: You give all sorts of commands, and you act so superior.
You givest many commands and actest haughtily.
PF68: The Creator does not come into the mind of the blind, idiotic, self-willed manmukh. ||1||
The blind, idiotic, perverse person thinks not of the creator.
GYZX: O my mind, the Lord is the Giver of peace.
O my soul! that God is the Giver of peace.
V27Q: By Guru's Grace, He is found. By His Mercy, He is obtained. ||1||Pause||
It is through Guru's grace that God is obtained. It is the good luck that you gettest Him. Pause.
4H79: People are entangled in the enjoyment of fine clothes, but gold and silver are only dust.
Man is entangled in the enjoyments of clothes and viands, the gold and silver which are but dust.
EDB7: They acquire beautiful horses and elephants, and ornate carriages of many kinds.
He has horses and elephants of many types and amasses untiring carriages.
BK6T: They think of nothing else, and they forget all their relatives.
He remembers none else and has forgotten all his kith and kin.
S70R: They ignore their Creator; without the Name, they are impure. ||2||
He has grown oblivious of the creator and is impure sans God's Name.
7QZ2: Gathering the wealth of Maya, you earn an evil reputation.
You earnest evil imprecation and amassest wealth.
B0Z8: Those whom you work to please shall pass away along with you.
He, whom you pleases, is perishable along with you.
HPAH: The egotistical are engrossed in egotism, ensnared by the intellect of the mind.
O proud Man! you takest pride and are engrossed in your mind's intellect.
CDYS: One who is deceived by God Himself, has no position and no honor. ||3||
He, whom the Lord Himself has put on the wrong track, has no caste and no honour.
SVVA: The True Guru, the Primal Being, has led me to meet the One, my only Friend.
The Divine True Guru has caused me to meet that Lord, the only friend of mine
FHR0: The One is the Saving Grace of His humble servant. Why should the proud cry out in ego?
The one Lord is the saviour of His slave. Why should a haughty man bewail in pride?
817M: As the servant of the Lord wills, so does the Lord act. At the Lord's Door, none of his requests are denied.
God does that what His saint wishes, No request of his is turned down from the God's court.
QHNF: Nanak is attuned to the Love of the Lord, whose Light pervades the entire Universe. ||4||1||71||
Nanak is imbued with love of God, whose light is pervading the entire universe.
5TM0: With the mind caught up in playful pleasures, involved in all sorts of amusements and sights that stagger the eyes, people are led astray.
Man's mind is gone astray in recreations, deep and varied amusements and the pleasure of eye-sight.
D6K5: The emperors sitting on their thrones are consumed by anxiety. ||1||
Even umbrellaed Emperors, are involved in anxiety.
K6PP: O Siblings of Destiny, peace is found in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
O Brother! I gathered peace in the society of saints.
UYVK: If the Supreme Lord, the Architect of Destiny, writes such an order, then anguish and anxiety are erased. ||1||Pause||
That Lord, the destiny scribe, wrote such a writ, and my anguish and anxiety are annulled. Pause.
0QT0: There are so many places-I have wandered through them all.
I have wandered through as many place as there are.
RR2S: The masters of wealth and the great land-lords have fallen, crying out, "This is mine! This is mine!" ||2||
The masters of wealth and big land-lords have fallen (perished) crying this is mine, this is mine.
U206: They issue their commands fearlessly, and act in pride.
They issues commands fearlessly and act in pride.
ULPD: They subdue all under their command, but without the Name, they are reduced to dust. ||3||
They have subdued all but without Lord's Name they mix with dust.
4XSU: Even those who are served by the 33 million angelic beings, at whose door the Siddhas and the Saadhus stand,
The monarch, at whose door stood as servants, the thirty three millions of God's and the men of miracle and strivers,
0NRJ: who live in wondrous affluence and rule over mountains, oceans and vast dominions-O Nanak, in the end, all this vanishes like a dream! ||4||2||72||
and who ruled over mountains oceans and empires, O Nanak! all have become like a dream.3

LGVW: Arising each day, you cherish your body, but you are idiotic, ignorant and without understanding.
Arising each day, the man cherishes his body, but without understanding the Lord, he is idiot and ignorant.
3QZ5: You are not conscious of God, and your body shall be cast into the wilderness.
That Lord he remembers not, (his body) shall be forsaken in wilderness.
FHT8: Focus your consciousness on the True Guru; you shall enjoy bliss forever and ever. ||1||
Attach the mind with The True Guru and enjoy bliss for ever and aye.
X06F: O mortal, you came here to earn a profit.
O mortal! you come to earn profit.
7VSH: What useless activities are you attached to? Your life-night is coming to its end. ||1||Pause||
With what useless task are you engaged? Your entire Night (life) is coming to an end. Pause.
XWVN: The animals and the birds frolic and play-they do not see death.
The animals and birds frisk about and behold not death.
L9TB: Mankind is also with them, trapped in the net of Maya.
With (like) them is also the man who is ensnared in the net of mammon.
BQJD: Those who always remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord, are considered to be liberated. ||2||
They alone who contemplate over the True Name, are considered to be emancipated.
MBYM: That dwelling which you will have to abandon and vacate-you are attached to it in your mind.
That house which is to be abandoned and vacated that is attached to the mind.
ZR2W: And that place where you must go to dwell-you have no regard for it at all.
You have no anxiety regarding the one where the have to go and dwell.
FS69: Those who fall at the Feet of the Guru are released from this bondage. ||3||
They, who fall at Guru's feet, are freed of the bondage.
9B41: No one else can save you-don't look for anyone else.
No one can save, without the Guru, I see none else.
GX9M: Chare kunda = all four directions, the whole world (the corners).
I have searched the whole creation and come to fall into the Guru's refuge.
I have searched in all four directions; I have come to find His Sanctuary.
I have searched the four directions and have come and entered Guru's sanctuary.
Having (bhal) searched all four (kunda) directions — east, west and the rest — I have come and reached the Guru's refuge.
U9T1: Sachai patisah = by the True King, by the Satguru. ||4||
O Nanak (say:) the True King, the Guru, has pulled me out as I was drowning (in the ocean of attachment to Maya). ||4||3||73||
O Nanak, the True King has pulled me out and saved me from drowning! ||4||3||73||
I was drowning (but Guru), the True king, has saved me, O Nanak!
Sri Guru ji says: the True King, who is the Guru, has had me, drowning in the world-ocean, pulled out by Parmeshvar. The meaning is: so you too should come to the Guru's refuge. ||4||3||73||
A5W9: For a brief moment, man is a guest of the Lord; he tries to resolve his affairs.
Man is a guest for a trice and moment in this world to set a right his affairs.
0JY1: Engrossed in Maya and sexual desire, the fool does not understand.
But the ignorant man understands not and is engrossed in wealth and lust.
19LS: He arises and departs with regret, and falls into the clutches of the Messenger of Death. ||1||
He arises and departs (from the world) repentingly and falls into the clutches of death myrmidon.
R1KC: You are sitting on the collapsing riverbank-are you blind?
O blind (Man)! you are sitting close to the falling shore of the river.
VJTP: If you are so pre-destined, then act according to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||Pause||
If you are so pre-destined, then act up to Guru's mandate. Pause.
7H2G: The Reaper does not look upon any as unripe, half-ripe or fully ripe.
The reaper (of the crop of life) neither sees unripe, nor half-ripe nor ripe.
R7S3: Picking up and wielding their sickles, the harvesters arrive.
Having made preparation, seizing and taking their sickles the croppers arrive.
BVMN: When the landlord gives the order, they cut and measure the crop. ||2||
When the Land Lord's order is issued then the field-crop reaped and measured.
J3VU: The first watch of the night passes away in worthless affairs, and the second passes in deep sleep.
The first watch of the night (life) passes in worthless affairs and during the second (mortal) sleeps to his fill.
LG4K: In the third, they babble nonsense, and when the fourth watch comes, the day of death has arrived.
In the third he prates nonsensically and in the fourth the day of death breaks.
4C4A: The thought of the One who bestows body and soul never enters the mind. ||3||
He who gave him soul and body never enters his mind.
JH2X: I am devoted to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I sacrifice my soul to them.
I am devoted to, and sacrifice my very life to the congregation of the righteous.
QZRL: Through them, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the All-knowing Lord God.
Through whom, understanding has entered my mind, and I have met the Omniscient Lord.
YPCN: Nanak sees the Lord always with him-the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||4||74||
Nanak sees ever with him the wise Lord, the knower of the hearts.
QW7N: Let me forget everything, but let me not forget the One Lord.
Let me forget everything, but forget not the One Lord.
3QAJ: All my evil pursuits have been burnt away; the Guru has blessed me with the Naam, the true object of life.
Having burnt (left) all the profane pursuits, the Guru has given God's Name, the true aim of life.
DXY1: Give up all other hopes, and rely on the One Hope.
Giving up all other hopes repose only in One Hope of God.
Z2RP: Those who serve the True Guru receive a place in the world hereafter. ||1||
They who serve the True Guru, secure a place in the younder world.
77QC: O my mind, praise the Creator.
O Mind! do you praise the Creator.
980G: Give up all your clever tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
Eschew all your cleverness and fall at the feet of the Guru. Pause.
7UB9: Pain and hunger shall not oppress you, if the Giver of Peace comes into your mind.
Pain and hunger shall oppress you not if God, the Giver of peace be in your mind.
J7LM: No undertaking shall fail, when the True Lord is always in your heart.
If that True Lord abides within man's mind, he fails in no under-taking of his.
9F8S: No one can kill that one to whom You, Lord, give Your Hand and protect.
He, whom You, O Lord, protects by giving Yours Hand, him none can slay.
KCHA: Serve the Guru, the Giver of Peace; He shall remove and wash off all your faults. ||2||
Wait upon Guru, the giver of peace, and he shall wash off all your sins.
N0B8: Your servant begs to serve those who are enjoined to Your service.
Your servant asks for the service of those, whom, You, O Lord! have put to Yours service.4

6RNP: The opportunity to work hard serving the Saadh Sangat is obtained, when the Divine Lord is pleased.
The association and the arduous service of Saints are obtained, if the Lord be mightily pleased.
S6LG: Everything is in the Hands of our Lord and Master; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
Everything is in the power of the Master. He Himself is the Doer of deeds.
DVTY: I am a sacrifice to the True Guru, who fulfills all hopes and desires. ||3||
I am a sacrifice to my True Guru, who fulfils all my aspirations.
3S1F: The One appears to be my Companion; the One is my Brother and Friend.
The unique Lord is seen to be my well-wisher and He alone is my brother and friend.
9F7H: The elements and the components are all made by the One; they are held in their order by the One.
All the goods are of the One Lord and He alone has bound every-thing in system.
ZARE: When the mind accepts, and is satisfied with the One, then the consciousness becomes steady and stable.
With One God, my soul is propitiated. It is then my mind is rendered stable.
9Z9R: Then, one's food is the True Name, one's garments are the True Name, and one's Support, O Nanak, is the True Name. ||4||5||75||
The True Name is Nanak's viand, True Name his raiment and the True Name he has made his prop.
SNWG: All things are received if the One is obtained.
I receive all the commodities if Him alone I obtain.
JFAW: The precious gift of this human life becomes fruitful when one chants the True Word of the Shabad.
The invaluable human life become fruitful, if the True Name be repeated.
XL02: One who has such destiny written on his forehead enters the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, through the Guru. ||1||
He, whose brow bear such a writ, obtains Lord presence through the Guru.
Y3D5: O my mind, focus your consciousness on the One.
O my soul! fix your attention with the one Lord.
39XJ: Without the One, all entanglements are worthless; emotional attachment to Maya is totally false. ||1||Pause||
Without one all else is but an entanglement. the love of mammon is all false. Pause.
YDNT: Hundreds of thousands of princely pleasures are enjoyed, if the True Guru bestows His Glance of Grace.
If the True Guru casts His merciful glance, I enjoy the happiness of lakhs of empires.
PL95: If He bestows the Name of the Lord, for even a moment, my mind and body are cooled and soothed.
Were he to bless me with His Name even for a trance, my soul and body will become cool.
HBL6: Those who have such pre-ordained destiny hold tight to the Feet of the True Guru. ||2||
They, who are so pre-ordained. hold fast the feet of the True Guru.
A0XR: Fruitful is that moment, and fruitful is that time, when one is in love with the True Lord.
Fruitful is the moment and fruitful the time when love for the True Lord is embraced.
Y5C6: Suffering and sorrow do not touch those who have the Support of the Name of the Lord.
Suffering and sorrow do not touch him, who has the support of God's Name.
7WE7: Grasping him by the arm, the Guru lifts them up and out, and carries them across to the other side. ||3||
Whom the Guru takes out, seizing by the arm he crosses the (Sea of Life).
C7SN: Embellished and immaculate is that place where the Saints gather together.
Embellished and immaculate is the place where the Saints' congregation is held.
A6SF: He alone finds shelter, who has met the Perfect Guru.
He alone who has found the Perfect Guru, obtains the place of protection.
HVVG: Nanak builds his house upon that site where there is no death, no birth, and no old age. ||4||6||76||
Nanak has founded his house on that (ground) where there is no death, birth and old age.
HL3U: Meditate on Him, O my soul; He is the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors.
O my Soul! meditate on Him who is the over Lord of Kings and emperors.
1HHR: Place the hopes of your mind in the One, in whom all have faith.
My mind! repose hope, in Him alone, in whom all have confidence.
4RTU: Give up all your clever tricks, and grasp the Feet of the Guru. ||1||
Shed all your clevernesses and take to the feet of the Guru.
DR1U: O my mind, chant the Name with intuitive peace and poise.
My Soul! with ease and calmness dwell upon God's Name.
GZRK: Twenty-four hours a day, meditate on God. Constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||Pause||
Through the eight watches (of the day), do you think of the Lord and ever sing the praises of the World illuminator. Pause.
JQEL: Seek His Shelter, O my mind; there is no other as Great as He.
Seek His shelter, O Soul! whom none equals in greatness.
QH61: Remembering Him in meditation, a profound peace is obtained. Pain and suffering will not touch you at all.
By remembering whom great peace is obtained and pain and distress absolutely touch (man) not.
971N: Forever and ever, work for God; He is our True Lord and Master. ||2||
Ever and for ever more perform the service of that True Lord Master.
3RJT: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, you shall become absolutely pure, and the noose of death shall be cut away.
In the society of Saints, the mortal becomes pure and the noose of death is cut.
XFBK: So offer your prayers to Him, the Giver of Peace, the Destroyer of fear.
Make supplication before Him who is the bestower of bliss and the destroyer of dread.
BNXA: Showing His Mercy, the Merciful Master shall resolve your affairs. ||3||
He, to whom the Merciful Master shows His mercy, has his affairs adjusted forth with.
2XV4: The Lord is said to be the Greatest of the Great; His Kingdom is the Highest of the High.
(The Lord) is spoken of as the greatest of the great and His seat the highest of the high.
1V3U: He has no color or mark; His Value cannot be estimated.
God is without colour and mark. (I) cannot appraise (His) worth.
5YNM: Please show Mercy to Nanak, God, and bless him with Your True Name. ||4||7||77||
Have mercy on Nanak, O Lord! and bless his with Your True Name.
G1GZ: One who meditates on the Naam is at peace; his face is radiant and bright.
He, who meditates on the Name is happy; his face becomes bright.
QM49: Obtaining it from the Perfect Guru, he is honored all over the world.
He, who obtains the Name from the Perfect Guru, becomes renowned all the Words over.
A9QH: In the Company of the Holy, the One True Lord comes to abide within the home of the self. ||1||
That Unique True (Everlasting Lord) abides in the house (society) of the saints.5

670P: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
My mind! contemplate the Lord God's Name.
S70J: The Naam is your Companion; it shall always be with you. It shall save you in the world hereafter. ||1||Pause||
The Name, your helper, is ever with you and shall save you hereafter. Pause.
75ZQ: Of what avail are the greatness of the world?
RDGQ: All the pleasures of Maya are tasteless and insipid. In the end, they shall all fade away.
When colour (pleasure) of worldly valuables is all fading. It shall disappear, O thoughtless. Fellow.
8RZT: Perfectly fulfilled and supremely acclaimed is the one, in whose heart the Lord abides. ||2||
Perfect and supreme is he, in whose heart God abides.
3Y79: Become the dust of the Saints; renounce your selfishness and conceit.
Be you dust of saints feet and renounce your self-conceit.
WKJR: Give up all your schemes and your clever mental tricks, and fall at the Feet of the Guru.
Shed all(other) endeavours and clevernesses and fall at the feet of the Guru.
8KBG: He alone receives the Jewel, upon whose forehead such wondrous destiny is written. ||3||
He alone receives the jewel of Name on whose brow good fortune is inscribed.
0WSW: O Siblings of Destiny, it is received only when God Himself bestows it.
He, whom the Lord Himself gives, obtains the Name O Brethren!
92WM: People serve the True Guru only when the fever of egotism has been eradicated.
He alone performs the service of the True Guru, who is rid of the affliction of ego.
F1F7: Nanak has met the Guru; all his sufferings have come to an end. ||4||8||78||
The Guru has met Nanak and so all his sufferings are at an end.
NAML: The One is the Knower of all beings; He alone is our Savior.
One Lord is the knower of man and He alone is his saviour.
VE39: The One is the Support of the mind; the One is the Support of the breath of life.
He alone is the mind's Support and He alone the Mainstay of life.
2S1K: In His Sanctuary there is eternal peace. He is the Supreme Lord God, the Creator. ||1||
In His refuge is all peace. He is the exalted Lord the Creator.
HDYZ: O my mind, give up all these efforts.
O my Mind! give up all (Other) efforts.
2QU7: Dwell upon the Perfect Guru each day, and attach yourself to the One Lord. ||1||Pause||
Each day think of the perfect Guru and embrace affection for the One Lord. Pause.
LSD8: The One is my Brother, the One is my Friend. The One is my Mother and Father.
The One Lord is the Brother, the One is the real Friend and the One my mother and Father.
5D9J: The One is the Support of the mind; He has given us body and soul.
Within my mind is the support of the Unique Lord who has given me the soul and the body.
V7X7: May I never forget God from my mind; He holds all in the Power of His Hands. ||2||
The Lord, who holds everything in His power, I may not forget Him within my mind.
SWHK: The One is within the home of the self, and the One is outside as well. He Himself is in all places and interspaces.
The One Lord is within (your) home (body) and the One without. he Himself is found within all the places.
XAGB: Meditate twenty-four hours a day on the One who created all beings and creatures.
Day in and day out, meditate on Him, who has made all the human and other beings.
6CBN: Attuned to the Love of the One, there is no sorrow or suffering. ||3||
By being imbued with the love of One God, sorrow and repentance visit man not.
XUXY: There is only the One Supreme Lord God; there is no other at all.
There is but One Supreme Lord Master. There is no other.
ME2P: Soul and body all belong to Him; whatever pleases His Will comes to pass.
The soul and body are all His, whatever pleases Him that comes to pass.
RL7A: Through the Perfect Guru, one becomes perfect; O Nanak, meditate on the True One. ||4||9||79||
Through the accomplished Guru the mortal becomes perfect by meditating on that True Lord.
X5M6: Those who focus their consciousness on the True Guru are perfectly fulfilled and famous.
Perfect and supreme are they, who fix their mind with the True Guru.
EZ3R: Spiritual wisdom wells up in the minds of those to whom the Lord Himself shows Mercy.
The Divine knowledge sprouts within the mind of those, to whom the Lord Himself becomes kind.
7UYZ: Those who have such destiny written upon their foreheads obtain the Name of the Lord. ||1||
They, who bear such a writ on their brow, receive God's Name.
U443: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the One Lord.
My mind! do you meditate on the One Name.
MST8: The happiness of all happiness shall well up, and in the Court of the Lord, you shall be dressed in robes of honor. ||1||Pause||
Thus shall spring the happiness of all the happiness and you shall go to God's Court, clad in robes of honour. Pause.
85KE: The fear of death and rebirth is removed by performing loving devotional service to the Lord of the World.
By performing the devotional service of the World-cherisher, the fear of birth and death is removed.
HPDC: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one becomes immaculate and pure; the Lord Himself takes care of such a one.
Man becomes pure in the society of the Guru and the Lord Himself nurtures him.
S4KQ: The filth of birth and death is washed away, and one is uplifted, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Guru's Darshan. ||2||
By beholding the light of the Guru, man is extremely delighted and his filth of coming (to) and going (from) (this world) is washed off.
Z3AL: The Supreme Lord God is pervading all places and interspaces.
That illimitable Lord is found in all the places.
HWYQ: The One is the Giver of all-there is no other at all.
God alone is the bestower of all. There is no other second.
M03R: In His Sanctuary, one is saved. Whatever He wishes, comes to pass. ||3||
By seeking His sanctuary man is saved. What Lord wishes to do that comes to pass.
5D0K: Perfectly fulfilled and famous are those, in whose minds the Supreme Lord God abides.
Perfect and supreme are they in whose heart the Exalted Lord dwells.
LP25: Their reputation is spotless and pure; they are famous all over the world.
Pure is their reputation, which is obvious all the world over.
475N: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who meditate on my God. ||4||10||80||
They, who have meditated on my Lord, Nanak is a sacrifice to them.6

866E: Meeting the True Guru, all my sufferings have ended, and the Peace of the Lord has come to dwell within my mind.
On meeting the True Guru all my affliction is over and divine peace has come and acquired an abode within my mind.
ZDZ5: The Divine Light illuminates my inner being, and I am lovingly absorbed in the One.
By enshrining love for One Lord, my heart is illumined with Diving light.
3ZZZ: Meeting with the Holy Saint, my face is radiant; I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.
By meeting the Guru my face has become clean and I have received what was pre-ordained for me.
MJDR: I constantly sing the Glories of the Lord of the Universe. Through the True Name, I have become spotlessly pure. ||1||
By ever singing the praises of the Lord of the world and the True Name, I have become blotless.
7100: O my mind, you shall find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad.
Through Guru's word, O my Mind! the man obtains peace.
MEU3: Working for the Perfect Guru, no one goes away empty-handed. ||1||Pause||
By performing the service of the perfect Guru, none goes empty handed.
TT5Z: The desires of the mind are fulfilled, when the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord, is obtained.
The mind's desires are fulfilled, when man finds the treasure of the Name.
K26B: The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, is always with you; recognize Him as the Creator.
The knower of hearts is ever with you. Do you realise Him, the Creator.
RW58: By Guru's Grace, your face shall be radiant. Chanting the Naam, you shall receive the benefits of giving charity and taking cleansing baths.
By Guru's grace the face becomes clean. Giving of alms and bathing (at shrines) are included in the Name's meditation.
CAZK: Sexual desire, anger and greed are eliminated, and all egotistical pride is abandoned. ||2||
Their all ego is abandoned and their lust, wrath and avarice are also eliminated.
N6HG: The Profit of the Naam is obtained, and all affairs are brought to fruition.
I have earned the gain and profit of God's Name and my affairs stand adjusted.
1YV6: In His Mercy, God unites us with Himself, and He blesses us with the Naam.
By His grace the Lord has given me His Name and united me with Himself.
M2HS: My comings and goings in reincarnation have come to an end; He Himself has bestowed His Mercy.
The Lord Himself has become merciful and my coming and going have ceased.
76VP: I have obtained my home in the True Mansion of His Presence, realizing the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||3||
By relishing the Guru's World I have obtained an abode in the True mansion.
NXFT: His humble devotees are protected and saved; He Himself showers His Blessings upon us.
Showering His benediction, the Lord protects the pious person.
ZQT0: In this world and in the world hereafter, radiant are the faces of those who cherish and enshrine the Glories of the True Lord.
In this world and the next, clean become the faces of those, who heartily remember the excellences of the True Lord.
CBYQ: Twenty-four hours a day, they lovingly dwell upon His Glories; they are imbued with His Infinite Love.
Throughout the eight watches of the day, they deliberate over God's attributes and are imbued with His infinite love.
CNNC: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God, the Ocean of Peace. ||4||11||81||
Nanak is ever a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord the Ocean of Comfort.
VD8D: If we meet the Perfect True Guru, we obtain the Treasure of the Shabad.
If we meet the Perfect Guru, we obtain the Name Treasure.
EXA3: Please grant Your Grace, God, that we may meditate on Your Ambrosial Naam.
My Master! show Yours mercy, so that we may meditate on the ambrosial Name.
XZQ9: The pains of birth and death are taken away; we are intuitively centered on His Meditation. ||1||
Thus the agony of birth and death is annulled and our attention gets, easily fixed on the Lord.
VQ3E: O my mind, seek the Sanctuary of God.
Seek you the sanctuary of the Lord, O my Mind!
9KFW: Without the Lord, there is no other at all. Meditate on the One and only Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||Pause||
Beside God, there is no other second. On His Name alone, do you meditate. Pause.
MC3J: His Value cannot be estimated; He is the Vast Ocean of Excellence.
His worth cannot be told (appraised). He is an unfathomable ocean of excellences.
NEYL: O most fortunate ones, join the Sangat, the Blessed Congregation; purchase the True Word of the Shabad.
Meeting with the society of saints, O very lucky Fellow purchase you the True name.
6V11: Serve the Lord, the Ocean of Peace, the Supreme Lord over kings and emperors. ||2||
Perform you the service of the ocean of solace. He is the Over Lord's of the kings and emperors.
2SXJ: I take the Support of the Lord's Lotus Feet; there is no other place of rest for me.
I have the sport of Lords lotus feet and know of no other place.
MA41: I lean upon You as my Support, O Supreme Lord God. I exist only by Your Power.
I lean on Your prop, O my Limitless Lord! and live by Yours might.
VMKT: O God, You are the Honor of the dishonored. I seek to merge with You. ||3||
Of the dishonoured, You are the honour, O Lord! I seed to blend with You.
LQPV: Chant the Lord's Name and contemplate the Lord of the World, twenty-four hours a day.
Throughout twenty-four hours ponder and contemplate over God, the World-sustainer.
F7ZY: He preserves our soul, our breath of life, body and wealth. By His Grace, He protects our soul.
He preserves man's soul, body and wealth and mercifully protects his very life.
27G6: O Nanak, all pain has been washed away, by the Supreme Lord God, the Forgiver. ||4||12||82||
You Lofty Lord Master is man's pardoner. He washes off all his sins, O Nanak!
UKN9: I have fallen in love with the True Lord. He does not die, He does not come and go.
I have contracted love with that True Lord! he dies, comes and goes not.
2GS8: In separation, He is not separated from us; He is pervading and permeating among all.
By separating He separates not and is contained among all.
BLD3: He is the Destroyer of the pain and suffering of the meek. He bears True Love for His servants.
Of the meek He is the remover of pang and affliction and to His slave He bears true love.
MN1E: Wondrous is the Form of the Immaculate One. Through the Guru, I have met Him, O my mother! ||1||
Wondrous is the from of the Immaculate One. The Guru has caused me to meet Him, O my Mother!
DG4R: O Siblings of Destiny, make God your Friend.
O Brother! make that Lord your friend.

P8YL: Cursed is emotional attachment and love of Maya; no one is seen to be at peace. ||1||Pause||
'Accursed is the love and attachment of wealth. With it none is seen at ease. Pause.
K1HH: God is Wise, Giving, Tender-hearted, Pure, Beautiful and Infinite.
The Lord is wise, beneficent tender hearted, pure, beautiful and infinite.
D53T: He is our Companion and Helper, Supremely Great, Lofty and Utterly Infinite.
He is the companion, helper, exceedingly exalted, lofty, great and illimitable.
42JS: He is not known as young or old; His Court is Steady and Stable.
He is not known as young or old. Ever stable is His Court.
6BKE: Whatever we seek from Him, we receive. He is the Support of the unsupported. ||2||
We obtain that, what we beg of Him. He is the Support of the supportless.
7TEF: Seeing Him, our evil inclinations vanish; mind and body become peaceful and tranquil.
By seeing the Lord, the soul and body are rendered peaceful.
Z7ZW: With one-pointed mind, meditate on the One Lord, and the doubts of your mind will be dispelled.
With single-mind meditation on One Lord, mind's misgiving is dispelled.
B2Y3: He is the Treasure of Excellence, the Ever-fresh Being. His Gift is Perfect and Complete.
He is the treasury of excellences and ever fresh is His body and complete His gift.
6XR3: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him. Day and night, do not forget Him. ||3||
For ever and aye meditate on God. Forget Him not by day and night.
R1HD: One whose destiny is so pre-ordained, obtains the Lord of the Universe as his Companion.
The Lord of the world is the comrade of those, who are so predestined.
CMGD: I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all to Him. I totally sacrifice my soul to Him.
To Him I dedicate my body, mind, wealth and all and this very life (soul) of mine, I all sacrifice to Him.
LYD6: Seeing and hearing, He is always close at hand. In each and every heart, God is pervading.
Pervading God ever sees, hears and is just near He resides in every heart.
V2YQ: Even the ungrateful ones are cherished by God. O Nanak, He is forever the Forgiver. ||4||13||83||
The Lord maintains (even) the ungrateful. He is ever the pardoner O Nanak!
XVXW: This mind, body and wealth were given by God, who naturally adorns us.
Who has given you soul, body and wealth, has established you with all power light within you.
6HN1: He has blessed us with all our energy, and infused His Infinite Light deep within us.
Who has bedecked you in the natural way, has established you with all power light within you.
9X58: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God; keep Him enshrined in your heart. ||1||
Ever and ever meditate upon and keep clasped to your heart and mind the Lord Master.
TW5K: O my mind, without the Lord, there is no other at all.
O my Soul! there is no other than God.
3VWT: Remain in God's Sanctuary forever, and no suffering shall afflict you. ||1||Pause||
Ever remain under Lord's protection and no affliction shall overtake you. Pause.
WEKQ: Jewels, treasures, pearls, gold and silver-all these are just dust.
The jewels, wealth, pearls, gold and silver are all dust.
D18V: Mother, father, children and relatives-all relations are false.
The Mother, father sons and kins are all false relation.
URF6: The self-willed manmukh is an insulting beast; he does not acknowledge the One who created him. ||2||
The perverse and impious beast understands not Him who created him.
79D2: The Lord is pervading within and beyond, and yet people think that He is far away.
Who is pervading within and without, Him he deems to be distant.
C8M5: They are engrossed in clinging desires; within their hearts there is ego and falsehood.
The desire is clinging to him and his heart is engrossed in pride and falsehood.
960P: Without devotion to the Naam, crowds of people come and go. ||3||
Crowds of mortals without devotion and the Name of God continue coming and going.
F9D6: Please preserve Your beings and creatures, God; O Creator Lord, please be merciful!
O Lord! the Creator mercifully preserve man and the other creatures.
MLBA: Without God, there is no saving grace. The Messenger of Death is cruel and unfeeling.
There is no protector but One Lord. Very unfeeling (is) or (has become) death's myrmidon.
G68H: O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam! Please bless me with Your Mercy, Lord! ||4||14||84||
Nanak, show Yours mercy to me, O God! so that I may not forget Your Name.
E44X: "My body and my wealth; my ruling power, my beautiful form and country-mine!"
The man says, I have the beauteous body, mine is the wealth and empire and country are exclusively mine.
KE2N: You may have children, a wife and many mistresses; you may enjoy all sorts of pleasures and fine clothes.
He may have sons, wife, many mistresses and may enjoy myriad of pleasures and raiments.
CQMR: And yet, if the Name of the Lord does not abide within the heart, none of it has any use or value. ||1||
If God's Name abides not within his mind they are of no avail and account.
NYVZ: O my mind, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.
O My Soul! contemplate over the Name of Lord Guru.
GGMW: Always keep the Company of the Holy, and focus your consciousness on the Feet of the Guru. ||1||Pause||
Ever associate with the society of the Saints and fix your mind on Guru's feet. Pause.
VX0Q: Those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads meditate on the Treasure of the Naam.
If good luck be recorded on the forehead, only then does man meditate on the Name-Treasure.
FXR3: All their affairs are brought to fruition, holding onto the Guru's Feet.
By being attached with Guru's feet all, the affairs become right.
HG26: The diseases of ego and doubt are cast out; they shall not come and go in reincarnation. ||2||
Thus are annulled the aliment of ego and scepticism and the mortal neither comes nor goes.
YCEL: Let the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, be your cleansing baths at the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
Mix you with the Saints' congregation and deem that your ablution at the sixty-eight places of pilgrimage.
H6QW: Your soul, breath of life, mind and body shall blossom forth in lush profusion; this is the true purpose of life.
Like this your soul, every life mind and body shall be reverdured and this is the true aim of life.8

AYEW: In this world you shall be blessed with greatness, and in the Court of the Lord you shall find your place of rest. ||3||
You shall gain glory here and obtain room in the next world.
JC3D: God Himself acts, and causes others to act; everything is in His Hands.
The Lord Himself does and causes others to do. Everything is in His hands.
1H04: He Himself bestows life and death; He is with us, within and beyond.
He Himself slays and revives. Within and without, He is with the mortal.
CVYG: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God, the Master of all hearts. ||4||15||85||
Nanak has sought the sanctuary of the Lord, who is the Master of all the bodies.
M8TH: The Guru is Merciful; we seek the Sanctuary of God.
They, to whom the Guru becomes merciful, seek their Lord's protection.
K9P6: Through the Teachings of the True Guru, all worldly entanglements are eliminated.
By the instruction of the True Guru all the worldly entanglement are annulled.
1RL5: The Name of the Lord is firmly implanted within my mind; through His Ambrosial Glance of Grace, I am exalted and enraptured. ||1||
The Name of the Omnipresent Lord has stuck in my mind and His ambrosial glance has exalted me.
AEGW: O my mind, serve the True Guru.
O my Soul! take you to the service of the True Guru.
8ZV2: God Himself grants His Grace; do not forget Him, even for an instant. ||Pause||
Forget not the Lord even for an instant from your mind. Then shall He shower His benediction on you. Pause.
FSV0: Continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, the Destroyer of demerits.
Ever sing the praises of the Lord of the world, who is the destroyer of demerits.
0SEJ: Without the Name of the Lord, there is no peace. Having tried all sorts of ostentatious displays, I have come to see this.
Without God's Name peace ensues not. By making various ostentations I have verified this.
WNTR: Intuitively imbued with His Praises, one is saved, crossing over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||
By being tinged with the Lord's praises in equipoise the mortal crosses the world-ocean.
HU9K: The merits of pilgrimages, fasts and hundreds of thousands of techniques of austere self-discipline are found in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
The merit of lakhs of pilgrimages, fastings and restraints is found in the dust of Saints' feet.
1PA9: From whom are you trying to hide your actions? God sees all;
From whom do you hide yours evil deeds, since the ever person Lord is beholding you.
J9AR: He is Ever-present. My God is totally pervading all places and interspaces. ||3||
My fully Filling Lord is pervading all the places.
35T9: True is His Empire, and True is His Command. True is His Seat of True Authority.
True is His empire, true His fiat and truest of the true His seat.
2MYR: True is the Creative Power which He has created. True is the world which He has fashioned.
True is the Omnipotence which he has created and true the World that He has fashioned.
VZEP: O Nanak, chant the True Name; I am forever and ever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||16||86||
Nanak, repeat the True Name, to which I am for ever and ever a sacrifice.
4VZ3: Make the effort, and chant the Lord's Name. O very fortunate ones, earn this wealth.
O you very fortunate! make effort, meditate on God and earn the wealth of Name.
LF1P: In the Society of the Saints, meditate in remembrance on the Lord, and wash off the filth of countless incarnations. ||1||
In the Society of saints, contemplate over God and wash off the filth of yours many births.
Q7VQ: O my mind, chant and meditate on the Name of the Lord.
O my mind! take to the meditation of the Name of Pervading God.
DMFD: Enjoy the fruits of your mind's desires; all suffering and sorrow shall depart. ||Pause||
You shall enjoy the fruit of your hearts desire and your sorrow and suffering shall all depart. Pause.
B8BQ: For His sake, you assumed this body; see God always with you.
I have seen with me the Lord, for seeking whom I assumed this body.
1KGN: God is pervading the water, the land and the sky; He sees all with His Glance of Grace. ||2||
The Lord who is pervading the Water, earth and the space beholds (every one) with his Grace.
Z0CH: The mind and body become spotlessly pure, enshrining love for the True Lord.
By enshrining affection for the True Lord, the soul and body become pure.
VRYN: One who dwells upon the Feet of the Supreme Lord God has truly performed all meditations and austerities. ||3||
He who thinks of the feet of Lofty Lord, he is deemed to have performed all the worships and austerities.
UA0N: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is a Gem, a Jewel, a Pearl.
The Name of God is like the Nectar, the Gem, the Ruby and the Pear.
EM3U: The essence of intuitive peace and bliss is obtained, O servant Nanak, by singing the Glories of God. ||4||17||87||
By singing the praises of God, O slave Nanak! celestial beatitude, the essence of all the happiness is obtained.
5Q9F: That is the essence of the scriptures, and that is a good omen, by which one comes to chant the Name of the Lord.
That is the religious book and that the good omen by which God's Name may be repeated.
VRTQ: The Guru has given me the Wealth of the Lotus Feet of the Lord, and I, without shelter, have now obtained Shelter.
The Guru has given me the wealth of Lord's Lotus Feet and I, the shelterless, have obtained a Shelter.
HMV5: The True Capital, and the True Way of Life, comes by chanting His Glories, twenty-four hours a day.
The true capital and true way of life consist in singing God's praises throughout the eight watches.
07T8: Granting His Grace, God meets us, and we no longer die, or come or go in reincarnation. ||1||
He, to whom the Lord shows mercy, meets Him He then dies comes and goes not.
0RUK: O my mind, vibrate and meditate forever on the Lord, with single-minded love.
O my Soul! ever meditated you on God with single minded affection.
X58H: He is contained deep within each and every heart. He is always with you, as your Helper and Support. ||1||Pause||
Your Succour, who resides in every heart, is ever with you. Pause.
P61R: How can I measure the happiness of meditating on the Lord of the Universe?
How can I measure the extent of the happiness which ensues when I meditate on the Lord of the world?
HUMR: Those who taste it are satisfied and fulfilled; their souls know this Sublime Essence.
The one who tastes the Name Nectar, gets satiated. His soul alone knows the relish of the Name Nectar.9

6ZDF: In the Society of the Saints, God, the Beloved, the Forgiver, comes to dwell within the mind.
Through the society of the saints the Beloved Lord, the pardoner abides in one's mind.
3Z17: One who has served his God is the emperor of kings||2||
He, who has served his Lord, is the emperor of kings of men (the emperors)
H56W: This is the time to speak and sing the Praise and the Glory of God, which brings the merit of millions of cleansing and purifying baths.
This is the time to utter the praises and excellences of God, by doing which the merit, of taking myriad of baths and ablutions at shrines, is obtained.
USTG: The tongue which chants these Praises is worthy; there is no charity equal to this.
The meritorious tongue repeats Lord's praises. No charity equals it.
L5EL: Blessing us with His Glance of Grace, the Kind and Compassionate, All-powerful Lord comes to dwell within the mind and body.
By casting His compassionate glance, the kind, Omnipotent and merciful Lord abides within man's mind and body.
2QP8: My soul, body and wealth are His. Forever and ever, I am a sacrifice to Him. ||3||
My very life body and wealth are His, I am ever and ever a sacrifice to Him.
57H6: One whom the Creator Lord has met and joined to Himself shall never again be separated.
The united one, whom the Creator has united with Himself, never separates.
GT85: The True Creator Lord breaks the bonds of His slave.
The True Maker has shattered the shackles of His attendants.
6H3G: The doubter has been put back on the path; his merits and demerits have not been considered.
Unheeding His merits and demerits, the Lord has put the erring on the right path.
NULY: Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of the One who is the Support of every heart. ||4||18||88||
Nanak has sought the sanctuary of Him, who is the support of all the hearts.
K406: With your tongue, repeat the True Name, and your mind and body shall become pure.
Repeat the True Name, with (your) tongue, so that (yours) mind and body may become pure.
2XJS: Your mother and father and all your relations-without Him, there are none at all.
Of your mother, father and all kith and kin, none shall be of any avail to have you without that God.
Y4RX: If God Himself bestows His Mercy, then He is not forgotten, even for an instant. ||1||
If the Lord shows His mercy, man forgets him not even for a moment.
UTC0: O my mind, serve the True One, as long as you have the breath of life.
O my Mind! serve you the True Lord, till you have breath (life).
B03K: Without the True One, everything is false; in the end, all shall perish. ||1||Pause||
Without the True One, all else is false and shall finally perish. Pause.
UMGC: My Lord and Master is Immaculate and Pure; without Him, I cannot even survive.
My Master is pure. Without Him I cannot live.
607Y: Within my mind and body, there is such a great hunger; if only someone would come and unite me with Him, O my mother!
Without my soul and body is very great hunger (desire) for God. Let some one Come and unite me with Him, O my Mother!
B00E: I have searched the four corners of the world-without our Husband Lord, there is no other place of rest. ||2||
I have searched the four directions. Without the Spouse there is no other place of rest.
H9PG: Offer your prayers to Him, who shall unite you with the Creator.
Make supplication before the Guru, who may unite you with the Creator.
AQLB: The True Guru is the Giver of the Naam; His Treasure is perfect and overflowing.
The Giver of (God's) Name is the True Guru whose Treasure is brimful.
G7AG: Forever and ever, praise the One, who has no end or limitation. ||3||
For ever and aye praise Him whose limit and either end cannot be ascertained.
91BN: Praise God, the Nurturer and Cherisher; His Wondrous Ways are unlimited.
Sing you the praises of the Nurturer, manifold are whose worderous plays.
S3Z7: Forever and ever, worship and adore Him; this is the most wonderful wisdom.
Ever and ever meditate on God. This alone is the excellent wisdom.
EKDB: O Nanak, God's Flavor is sweet to the minds and bodies of those who have such blessed destiny written on their foreheads. ||4||19||89||
Nanak, the Lord flavours sweet to the mind and body of him, who has good luck recorded on his brow.
VQ1D: Meet with the humble Saints, O Siblings of Destiny, and contemplate the True Name.
O Brethren! meeting the society of the holy persons, deliberate over the True Name.
39X3: For the journey of the soul, gather those supplies which will go with you here and hereafter.
For the soul blind (gather) you the viaticum of the True Name which shall be with you, here and here-after.
A9FX: These are obtained from the Perfect Guru, when God bestows His Glance of Grace.
If the Lord looks with His favour, you shall obtain this (viaticum) from the perfect Guru.
XY4P: Those to whom He is Merciful, receive His Grace. ||1||
He to whom God becomes merciful becomes the recipient of His Grace.
3R1T: O my mind, there is no other as great as the Guru.
My mind, none else is so great as the Guru.
H984: I cannot imagine any other place. The Guru leads me to meet the True Lord. ||1||Pause||
I can think of no other place. The Guru alone can cause me to meet that True Lord. Pause.
TL23: Those who go to see the Guru obtain all treasures.
He, who goes and beholds the Guru, obtains all the valuables.
89WU: Those whose minds are attached to the Guru's Feet are very fortunate, O my mother.
O My Mother! Exceedingly lucky, are they, whose mind is attached with Guru's feet.
0KC8: The Guru is the Giver, the Guru is All-powerful. The Guru is All-pervading, contained among all.
The Guru is the Donor, the Guru the Omnipotent Being and the Guru is contained among all.
UV91: The Guru is the Transcendent Lord, the Supreme Lord God. The Guru lifts up and saves those who are drowning. ||2||
The Guru is the Supreme Lord and the Transcendent Master. The Guru floats (saves) the drowning one.
EERT: How shall I praise the Guru, the All-powerful Cause of causes?
With what mouth should I eulogize the Guru, who is capable of doing everything.
HNZB: Those, upon whose foreheads the Guru has placed His Hand, remain steady and stable.
Ever stable remain the brows (men) on whom the Guru has put his hand.
EHAY: The Guru has led me to drink in the Ambrosial Nectar of the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He has released me from the cycle of birth and death.
The Guru has causes me to quaff ambrosial Name, the destroyer of birth and death.
EW80: I serve the Guru, the Transcendent Lord, the Dispeller of fear; my suffering has been taken away. ||3||
I have served the Guru, the embodiment of Lord and the dispeller of dread and my agony is eliminated.0

K7NV: The True Guru is the Deep and Profound Ocean of Peace, the Destroyer of sin.
The True Guru is the profound and unfathomable Ocean of Peace and the destroyer of sin.
2EC9: For those who serve their Guru, there is no punishment at the hands of the Messenger of Death.
He who has served his Guru for him there is no punishment of the death's myrmidon.
EAC0: There is none to compare with the Guru; I have searched and looked throughout the entire universe.
There is no one at par with the Guru. I have searched and seen the whole universe.
W4PR: The True Guru has bestowed the Treasure of the Naam, the Name of the Lord. O Nanak, the mind is filled with peace. ||4||20||90||
The True Guru has given the Name treasure and Nanak has thereby enshrined solace in him mind.
NJZX: People eat what they believe to be sweet, but it turns out to be bitter in taste.
People eat what they believe to be sweet (man enjoys worldly pleasures) but those turn out to be bitter in taste.
3KD3: They attach their affections to brothers and friends, uselessly engrossed in corruption.
Absurd it is to contract affection with brothers and friends and to be engrossed in sins.
EPTG: They vanish without a moment's delay; without God's Name, they are stunned and amazed. ||1||
In vanishing they make no delay, without God's Name man is confounded in distress.
5GN7: O my mind, attach yourself to the service of the True Guru.
O my Soul! apply yourself to the True Guru's Service.
SPLG: Whatever is seen, shall pass away. Abandon the intellectualizations of your mind. ||1||Pause||
Whatever is seen, that shall perish. Abandon you, O man your mind's cleverness. Pause.
MZS8: Like the mad dog running around in all directions,
As the rabid dog runs and wanders about in the ten (all) directions,
5RXV: the greedy person, unaware, consumes everything, edible and non-edible alike.
similarly the greedy man heeds nothing and devours all what is eatable and not-eatable.
ZZTC: Engrossed in the intoxication of sexual desire and anger, people wander through reincarnation over and over again. ||2||
He, who is eatable in lust, anger and ego, takes birth again and again.
EKPA: Maya has spread out her net, and in it, she has placed the bait.
Mammon has spread out its net and in it has placed the bait.
4TAF: The bird of desire is caught, and cannot find any escape, O my mother.
The avaricious bird is snared and cannot escape, O my Mother!
GF51: One who does not know the Lord who created him, comes and goes in reincarnation over and over again. ||3||
Man knows (remembers) not Him, who created his and continues coming and going over and over again.
HEUU: By various devices, and in so many ways, this world is enticed.
This world has been bewitched in various ways and good many devices.
105A: They alone are saved, whom the All-powerful, Infinite Lord protects.
He, whom the Omnipotent and Infinite Lord protects is saved.
TTRY: The servants of the Lord are saved by the Love of the Lord. O Nanak, I am forever a sacrifice to them. ||4||21||91||
Nanak is ever a sacrifice to God's serfs, who are saved through God's affection.
KKS0: Siree Raag, Fifth Mehl, Second House:
0AYA: The herdsman comes to the pasture lands-what good are his ostentatious displays here?
When a herdsman comes to the pasture land, of what avail is his making ostentatious displays over there?
JHK4: When your allotted time is up, you must go. Take care of your real hearth and home. ||1||
When the time allowed is completed, you must depart, (O herdsman!) Do you take care of your real hearth and home.
XD39: O mind, sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and serve the True Guru with love.
O my mind! sing the excellences of God and serve the True Guru with love.
8K97: Why do you take pride in trivial matters? ||1||Pause||
Why takest you pride on a trivial thing? Pause.
3TJV: Like an overnight guest, you shall arise and depart in the morning.
Like the night guest you shall be up to depart in the morn.
GDFS: Why are you so attached to your household? It is all like flowers in the garden. ||2||
Why are you bewitched of your house hold? Everything is short-lived like orchard flowers.
LC3N: Why do you say, "Mine, mine"? Look to God, who has given it to you.
Why sayest you This is mind, that is mine, Seek the Lord who gave it to you.
EW8M: It is certain that you must arise and depart, and leave behind your hundreds of thousands and millions. ||3||
You must assuredly get up and depart and leave behind a hundred thousand and millions (of rupees).
RAZU: Through 8.4 million incarnations you have wandered, to obtain this rare and precious human life.
Having wandered through eighty four lakhs of existences, thouhast obtained the scarcely procurable human life.
WTMF: O Nanak, remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the day of departure is drawing near! ||4||22||92||
Nanak, remember you the Name, for that day of departure is drawing near.
T86P: As long as the soul-companion is with the body, it dwells in happiness.
As long as, Soul it's companion, is with the body so long it lives happily.
HMRW: But when the companion arises and departs, then the body-bride mingles with dust. ||1||
When the comrade gets up and depart then the body bride mingles with dust.
NTAU: My mind has become detached from the world; it longs to see the Vision of God's Darshan.
My mind has developed absence of worldly desires and has ambition to behold Lord's sight.
J3BP: Blessed is that seat of Yours (O Master!). Pause.
5HHL: As long as the soul-husband dwells in the body-house, everyone greets you with respect.
As long as the soul spouse dwells in the house (body) every one says "Sir, sire".
V8MN: But when the soul-husband arises and departs, then no one cares for you at all. ||2||
When the soul spouse shall get up and depart no one shall care for you then.
9647: In this world of your parents' home, serve your Husband Lord; in the world beyond, in your in-laws' home, you shall dwell in peace.
In parents home (this world) do you serve your Bridegroom and abide in peace in your father -in-laws (the next world).
FV4H: Meeting with the Guru, be a sincere student of proper conduct, and suffering shall never touch you. ||3||
By meeting the Guru, learn discretion and pious conduct and sorrow shall never befall you.
DN46: Everyone shall go to their Husband Lord. Everyone shall be given their ceremonial send-off after their marriage.
All shall go to their bridegroom's and all shall have ceremonial permanent departure after marriage.1
